control_failures.control_label: arc flash boundary and protective equipment
earth leakage and protection setting integrity
proving zero energy before intrusive work

facts.title: unplanned release of thermal energy at TX-7001

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control ARC_FLASH_PPE_AND_BOUNDARY: the arc flash boundary and protective equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.
Control ZERO_ENERGY_VERIFICATION: the proving zero energy before intrusive work was never verified as effective, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the arc flash boundary and protective equipment on TX-7001 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on TX-7001 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the proving zero energy before intrusive work on TX-7001 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. TX-7001 (terminal switchgear) is in service for terminal distribution. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the arc flash boundary and protective equipment had degraded below its design intent. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 17 February 2010 a hazard report was recorded on TX-7001 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during commissioning of replacement equipment; thermal energy held as hot surface was not released.
